Nkyerɛkyerɛ pa
1 # 1 Ti 6.3; 2 Ti 1.13 Na wo deɛ, ka nsɛm a ɛfata nkyerɛkyerɛ pa no. 2#1 Ti 5.1 Nkɔkoraa ani so nna hɔ, wɔn anim nyɛ duru, wɔn adwene mu nte, wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn den, gyidie, ɔdɔ, ne boasetɔ fam. 3#1 Ti 3.11 Mmerewa nso mmu wɔn bra sɛdeɛ ɛfata nnipa kronkron, wɔnnni nsekuro, wɔnnyɛ asadweam, wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm pa, 4na wɔde ate mmabaa adwene mu ama wɔadɔ wɔn kununom ne wɔn mma, 5#Efe 5.22 na wɔadwene adwempa, ahwɛ wɔn ho so, ayɛ wɔn afie yie, ayɛ adɛɛfoɔ, abrɛ wɔn ho ase ama wɔn ara wɔn kununom, na wɔanka Nyankopɔn asɛm no ho asɛmmɔne.
6Mmeranteɛ nso saa ara na tu wɔn foɔ, na wɔnnwene adwempa. 7#1 Ti 4.12; 1 Pe 5.3 Na biribiara mu no, yi wo ho adi sɛ nnwuma pa nhwɛsoɔ, nkyerɛkyerɛ mu yi pɛyɛ, animuduro, 8#1 Pe 2.15 asɛmpa a ɛyɛ a wɔnnya ho asɛm bi nka adi, na deɛ ɔne yɛn anya no afɛre, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnni yɛn ho bɔne biara ka. 9#Efe 6.5; 1 Ti 6.1; 1 Pe 2.18 Nkoa nso, wɔmmrɛ wɔn ho ase mma wɔn ara wɔn wuranom, wɔnsɔ wɔn ani adeɛ nyinaa mu, wɔnntuatua nsɛm ano, 10#Tito 1.3 wɔnnwia nnoɔma nketenkete, na mmom wɔnyi nokorɛ pa nyinaa nkyerɛ; na wɔde atoto yɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ kwan mu, adeɛ nyinaa mu.
11Na Nyankopɔn adom a ɛde nkwagyeɛ ba ma nnipa nyinaa no ayi ne ho. 12#Efe 1.4 Na ɛyɛne yɛn, sɛ, sɛ yɛapa mmusubɔ ne wiase akɔnnɔ a, yɛmfa adwenemuteɛ ne tenenee ne onyamesom pa ntena wiase berɛ yi mu, 13#1 Ko 1.7; Flp 3.20 ntwɛn Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ ne yɛn Agyenkwa Kristo Yesu ahotɔ anidasoɔ ne n’animuonyam ahoyie. 14#Gal 1.4; 1 Ti 2.6; Efe 2.10 Ɔno na ɔde ne ho maeɛ, maa yɛn, na wagye yɛn afiri mmarato nyinaa mu, na wadwira ɔman bi ho ayɛ ɔno ara ne deɛ a wɔbɔ nnwuma pa ho mmɔden. 15#1 Ti 4.12 Yeinom na fa tumi nyinaa ka, na tu ho foɔ, na yi ho atɛn. Mma obi mmmu wo animtia.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na wo deɛ, ka nsɛm a ɛfata nkyerɛkyerɛ pa no. Nkɔkoraa ani so nna hɔ, wɔn anim nyɛ duru, wɔn adwene mu nte, wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn den, gyidie, ɔdɔ, ne boasetɔ fam. Mmerewa nso mmu wɔn bra sɛdeɛ ɛfata nnipa kronkron, wɔnnni nsekuro, wɔnnyɛ asadweam, wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm pa, na wɔde ate mmabaa adwene mu ama wɔadɔ wɔn kununom ne wɔn mma, na wɔadwene adwempa, ahwɛ wɔn ho so, ayɛ wɔn afie yie, ayɛ adɛɛfoɔ, abrɛ wɔn ho ase ama wɔn ara wɔn kununom, na wɔanka Nyankopɔn asɛm no ho asɛmmɔne.
Mmeranteɛ nso saa ara na tu wɔn foɔ, na wɔnnwene adwempa. Na biribiara mu no, yi wo ho adi sɛ nnwuma pa nhwɛsoɔ, nkyerɛkyerɛ mu yi pɛyɛ, animuduro, asɛmpa a ɛyɛ a wɔnnya ho asɛm bi nka adi, na deɛ ɔne yɛn anya no afɛre, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnni yɛn ho bɔne biara ka. Nkoa nso, wɔmmrɛ wɔn ho ase mma wɔn ara wɔn wuranom, wɔnsɔ wɔn ani adeɛ nyinaa mu, wɔnntuatua nsɛm ano, wɔnnwia nnoɔma nketenkete, na mmom wɔnyi nokorɛ pa nyinaa nkyerɛ; na wɔde atoto yɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ kwan mu, adeɛ nyinaa mu.
Na Nyankopɔn adom a ɛde nkwagyeɛ ba ma nnipa nyinaa no ayi ne ho. Na ɛyɛne yɛn, sɛ, sɛ yɛapa mmusubɔ ne wiase akɔnnɔ a, yɛmfa adwenemuteɛ ne tenenee ne onyamesom pa ntena wiase berɛ yi mu, ntwɛn Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ ne yɛn Agyenkwa Kristo Yesu ahotɔ anidasoɔ ne n’animuonyam ahoyie. Ɔno na ɔde ne ho maeɛ, maa yɛn, na wagye yɛn afiri mmarato nyinaa mu, na wadwira ɔman bi ho ayɛ ɔno ara ne deɛ a wɔbɔ nnwuma pa ho mmɔden. Yeinom na fa tumi nyinaa ka, na tu ho foɔ, na yi ho atɛn. Mma obi mmmu wo animtia.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
